content.title: THE REAL REASON YOUR {{BLOATING}} WON'T GO AWAY
facts: **Fennel seeds** – chew 1 tsp after meals, they relax gut muscles and let trapped gas escape faster.
**Papaya** – 1 cup after lunch; its enzyme papain breaks down stubborn proteins your gut struggles with.
**Peppermint tea** – 1 cup post-meal calms the intestinal lining and eases cramping within minutes.
**Cucumber** – 90% water plus quercetin, it flushes excess sodium that causes puffy, bloated bellies.
**Ginger root** – a thumb-sized piece grated into tea speeds up stomach emptying so food doesn't sit and ferment.
**Bananas** – 1 ripe banana/day balances potassium levels, pulling extra water out from under the skin.
**Asparagus** – a natural diuretic that works with your kidneys to drain water weight overnight.
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
Bloating is one of those small, annoying problems almost nobody talks about, but your kitchen probably already has the fix. Fennel seeds work by relaxing the smooth muscles lining your digestive tract, which lets gas move through instead of getting trapped and causing that tight, swollen feeling. Papaya contains papain, an enzyme that breaks down proteins your stomach acid alone can't fully digest, so less undigested food sits around fermenting and producing gas. Ginger speeds up gastric emptying, meaning food spends less time sitting in your stomach where it can bubble and cause pressure. Everyone's gut reacts a little differently, so pay attention to what actually settles yours.
